yorum: Sentido Bellazure in Akyarlar is an absolute gem on the Bodrum map a place you will want to return to with pure delight. This hotel has a certain magic that makes no other place compare. Breathtaking views: The hilltop location offers a spectacular panorama of the blue bay and the Greek island of Kos. Drinking your morning coffee on the terrace here is truly priceless. Warm-hearted staff: The staff don't just do their jobs; they genuinely care about every guest. Their hospitality, smiles, and flawless service make you feel at home immediately. Culinary paradise: Meals at Sentido Bellazure are a real feast for the palate. The choice of dishes is huge, everything is fresh and everything is served with the utmost care. Private relaxation area: An intimate, private beach and crystal-clear water provide the perfect conditions for unwinding. The experience is perfectly complemented by great pools and a fantastic spa center.

We arrived at the hotel on the evening of June 13th, and so far we have been having a wonderful experience. Of course, the facilities are excellent and the food is very good, but what truly makes the difference are your people. From the reception team, concierge services, bars and restaurants, all the way to the beach staff, we have consistently encountered professionalism, kindness, and genuine hospitality. On this occasion, I would particularly like to recognize four members of your team: Resit, Emrullah, Bavur, and Zeynep. Their positive attitude, attentiveness, and dedication have made our stay even more enjoyable. I sincerely hope that you take good care of your staff, as they are the real differentiating factor in an era when facilities and food quality have become relatively standardized across the hospitality industry. We look forward to returning next year.
